title: The Dentist Who Infected 9,000 Patients with HIV
hook: A Florida dentist deliberately infected his own patients with HIV, and the government let him keep practicing.
why_this_can_go_viral: The betrayal of trust by a medical professional plus a massive body count triggers outrage and morbid curiosity.

title: The FDA-Approved Drug That Turned Babies Blue
hook: A popular infant gas medication was approved by the FDA, but it caused babies' skin to turn permanently blue.
why_this_can_go_viral: Shocking visual of blue babies combined with FDA failure creates high shareability and outrage.

title: The Lupus Cure That Was Hidden by Drug Companies
hook: A cheap, effective lupus treatment was discovered in the 1990s, then buried by pharmaceutical executives.
why_this_can_go_viral: Millions of lupus sufferers exist; the idea of a suppressed cure fuels anger and shares.

title: How a Hospital Secretly Sold Patients' Brains Without Permission
hook: A major hospital chain was caught selling patients' brains to research labs without ever telling families.
why_this_can_go_viral: Body part trafficking triggers deep unease and moral outrage, making viewers want to know more.

title: The Doctor Who Experimented on Coma Patients Without Consent
hook: A neurologist secretly injected comatose patients with experimental viruses to study brain death.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vulnerability of comatose patients combined with doctor betrayal creates visceral horror.

title: The Painkiller That Was Just a Sugar Pill — and Made Millions
hook: A bestselling painkiller contained zero active ingredients, yet patients reported feeling relief — and addiction.
why_this_can_go_viral: The placebo effect exposed as a billion-dollar fraud makes people question all medicine they take.

title: The Contraceptive That Caused Permanent Sterilization in Thousands
hook: A popular birth control shot was linked to irreversible infertility, but manufacturers hid the data for years.
why_this_can_go_viral: Reproductive health is deeply personal; the idea of forced sterilization triggers massive emotional response.

title: The Cancer Epidemic That Was Caused by a Factory
hook: A small town had a 300% higher cancer rate — until investigators found a single factory releasing poison for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: Environmental cancer clusters are terrifying because they could happen anywhere; locality drives shares.

title: The Hospital That Removed Healthy Kidneys for Organs
hook: A surgeon was caught removing kidneys from living patients who came in for minor procedures — and selling them.
why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate medical horror — going in for a checkup and losing an organ — is universally terrifying.

title: The Chemotherapy Drug That Caused Cancer in Patients
hook: A widely used chemo drug was discovered to cause new, aggressive cancers years after treatment.
why_this_can_go_viral: The irony of a cancer treatment causing cancer is deeply unsettling and high-share in cancer communities.

title: How a Vitamin Company Laced Supplements with Rat Poison
hook: A popular vitamin brand secretly added warfarin — a rat poison — to their supplements to increase effectiveness.
why_this_can_go_viral: Trust in supplements is shattered instantly; the visual of rat poison in vitamins is highly shareable.

title: The Doctor Who Deliberately Gave Patients Cancer for Research
hook: A respected oncologist injected cancer cells into healthy patients to study tumor growth — and got away with it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate violation of medical ethics — actively giving cancer — shocks and horrifies everyone.

title: The Weight Loss Drug That Caused Permanent Heart Damage
hook: A blockbuster obesity drug was linked to irreversible heart valve damage, but the company hid it for a decade.
why_this_can_go_viral: Obesity drugs are hugely popular; the idea that they cause permanent damage triggers panic and shares.

title: The Medical Device That Electrocuted Patients During Surgery
hook: An FDA-approved surgical tool was malfunctioning and delivering fatal electric shocks to patients on the operating table.
why_this_can_go_viral: Fear of dying on the operating table is primal; a defective device amplifies that terror.

title: The Hospital That Billed Patients for Cuddles and Hugs
hook: A hospital system was caught charging patients hundreds of dollars for 'therapeutic embraces' and skin-to-skin contact.
why_this_can_go_viral: Absurdity and outrage combine; the visual of a 'hug' on a medical bill is highly shareable.

title: The Antibiotic That Was Found to Cause Aortic Aneurysms
hook: A commonly prescribed antibiotic was linked to bursting arteries, but warnings were added years after millions took it.
why_this_can_go_viral: Fluoroquinolones are widely used; the hidden risk of artery rupture is terrifying for anyone who has taken them.

title: The Doctor Who Prescribed Chemo to Healthy Patients for Profit
hook: An oncologist was caught giving chemotherapy to patients who didn't have cancer — just to bill insurance.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of being poisoned with chemo when you're healthy is a nightmare scenario that drives outrage.

title: The Sleep Drug That Made People Drive and Cook in Their Sleep
hook: A popular insomnia medication caused users to sleepwalk, drive cars, and even cook meals with no memory of it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The bizarre, almost horror-movie behavior of sleep-driving is fascinating and terrifying, perfect for short video.

title: How a Hospital System Faked Cancer Diagnoses for Billions
hook: A major hospital chain was found to have falsely diagnosed thousands of patients with cancer to charge for treatment.
why_this_can_go_viral: The ultimate betrayal — being told you have cancer when you don't — triggers intense fear and anger.

title: The Vaccine That Caused a Deadly Autoimmune Epidemic
hook: A recommended vaccine was linked to a surge in autoimmune diseases, but health officials dismissed the data.
why_this_can_go_viral: Vaccine safety is a hot-button issue; autoimmune links are underreported, making this a high-engagement topic.

title: The Doctor Who Experimented on Pregnant Women Without Consent
hook: A researcher injected pregnant women with experimental drugs to see if they would harm the fetus — and never told them.
why_this_can_go_viral: Harming unborn babies is one of the most emotionally charged violations possible, driving massive shares.

title: The Pain Reliever That Was Actually a Heroin Substitute
hook: A bestselling painkiller was chemically almost identical to heroin, but was marketed as a safe alternative.
why_this_can_go_viral: The opioid crisis is a major topic; showing how close a legal drug was to heroin is eye-opening and shareable.

title: The Hospitals That Dumped Infectious Waste in Poor Neighborhoods
hook: A network of hospitals was caught dumping used needles and infected blood in low-income communities for decades.
why_this_can_go_viral: Environmental injustice combined with medical waste triggers class anger and horror about hidden pollution.

title: The Drug Company That Paid Doctors to Fake Patient Deaths
hook: A pharmaceutical firm paid physicians to report that patients died of natural causes when they died from the drug.
why_this_can_go_viral: The conspiracy-level cover-up of drug deaths by paying doctors is deeply unsettling and drives intense curiosity.

title: The Cancer Treatment That Was Just a Bleach Cocktail
hook: A clinic charged cancer patients thousands for an 'alternative cure' that was literally industrial bleach drunk orally.
why_this_can_go_viral: The absurdity and danger of drinking bleach as a 'cure' triggers disbelief and anger, perfect for sharing.
